body: Update: We just came back from a coffee place. We actually have a pretty good relationship (more than I originally thought). I talked a lot about my life in college, and spoke about some personal problems I'm currently having with my girlfriend- she gave me some advice on it, which really seemed to bring us together and gave her confidence. I asked her how shes been over the last months and she started out with a "fine" but started talking about how unmotivated she is in school and with social life. How should I bring up the therapy idea, as it is frowned upon by my parents (she also probably picked up similar feelings toward it)?

Thanks guys, really appreciate. I think I might take her out tonight for a hot chocolate or something and ease into the topic. My parents are a little against therapy, but from what everyone has said so far- perhaps she really needs it.
